title: pretty ORLA|Plus Size Floral Embroidered Sequin Ruffle Sleeve Tulle Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This one’s made for plus size formal nights where you want coverage and shape, not cling. The V-neck sits well on a fuller bust, and the sheer flutter sleeves cover the top of the arms without feeling tight. The embroidered sequin bodice keeps the look dressy, while the tulle skirt falls straight down and doesn’t grab at the hips or thighs. If you‘re shopping for a?plus size formal dress for a wedding or a gala, this is an easy, reliable pick.

Best For

  • Plus size formal wedding guest dresses

  • Black-tie optional events

  • Galas and evening receptions

  • Bust-friendly neckline + arm coverage

  • A skirt that skims, not clings


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretchy.
